sentences.translation: A mother duck lives on the farm.
One day, little chicks will come.
The duckling runs away from the farm.
It goes through meadows and fields.
It is looking for friends, but no one wants to play with it.
He finds a small house and sleeps there.
In spring, the sun comes back.
The duckling goes to the lake.
It sees his image in the water.
The duckling finally feels at home.
The farmer's children look at the lake.
On the farm, the ducks hear about the new swan.
The old duck mother is surprised.
She goes to the lake and apologizes.
The duckling sometimes visits the farm, but it lives by the lake.
It now knows: being different is okay.
The weather is terrible today. I don’t like the sun. It’s too warm.
It sings softly with the other swans.
It sleeps well in the evening.
The next day, the children play on the shore.
They throw bread into the water.
